9.name: Returns
9.content:
Returning Policy: Defective Items "Dead on Arrival" 
-----------------------------------------------------

Unless you have purchased a product which is sold "as-is" or "without warranty", we gladly accept defective products for refund.
At the sole discretion of Pinball Engine, we will issue a credit note, send a new replacement item, or repair the product. All costs associated with the return back to our warehouse are to be paid by you, and we will pay for the cost of shipping the replacement item back to you. 

Please do not send the goods unless you receive a reference number from our support team.


Returning Policy: Non-Defective Items
--------------------------------------

In general, we do not accept returns for change of mind, parts not suitable, and so on. Because amusement parts and machines are unique and often ordered specially for you, the chance of us being able to sell to others quickly is very difficult. Because of this, we are not able to support you for refunds/returns. However, if the goods have not yet been ordered/customized on our side and still have not started their freight to you, we will work with you for solutions. In all cases, we will do our best to support you.
